title: Rest And Still Rise (Soul Rise)
style: soul with a two-part arc, brooding 62-68 bpm opening lifting to an upbeat 100-112 bpm groove at the turn, warm piano and round bass foundation, percussion thickening as it lifts, triumphant horn stabs and claps from the turnaround, hopeful minor-to-major resolution, close dry upfront vocal, single continuous take. Warm female lead, sung melody with long held open vowels, rising in register after the turn. The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes. Only the short intro and the final outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them, natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades.
negative_tags: rap, rapping, choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery

kie_params.duration: delivered seconds (L-2); G9 headroom question is open decision 3 in file 18

segments.lyrics:
[Intro (spoken): close dry voice, plain speech, no melody]
Two in the morning. Running on empty again.

[Vocalise (sung): wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes]
Ooh-oo-ooh, ooh-oo-ooh

[Verse 1 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I rise before the su-un,
the coffee's barely do-one,
I pack the lunches ti-ight,
I'm on the train by li-ight,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 2 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The bills stack on the ta-able,
I smile like I am a-able,
Two in the morning, sti-ill,
I cannot climb this hi-ill,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Build (sung): melodic, rising, tempo lifting]
A friend sat by my si-ide,
she said, you need not hi-ide,

[Product (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
She handed me a bo-ook,
The Unhurried Year, look,
Each page said slow and sta-ay,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Bridge (sung): upbeat groove, rising]
I slowed my mornings dow-own,
I laid the heavy crow-own,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Outro (spoken): calm close voice, plain speech, no melody]
The Unhurried Year by Dana Wells. Rest is not quitting. Get the book today and take your mornings back.

[End]
